request:
镜头 s14：纪录片采访镜头，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：a clean oral-history documentary interview recorded in 2078 on a Sony FX6 with a 50mm lens at f/2.8: one soft key light from the left with gentle falloff, true-to-life skin texture, shallow depth of field, neutral colour, calm and restrained
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary talking-head interview, tripod camera, subject looks past the lens at the interviewer
导演意图（自然语言）：采访固定机位，近景。波爷低着头，苦笑了一下，说完把目光移开。环境声：安静房间的底噪。
情绪：remorseful, quiet, honest
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：close-up, locked-off interview camera
景深与虚实：Very shallow depth of field, only his eyes and glasses sharp.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Oral-history interview close-up: Boye, 64, in the dim concrete room, glasses back on, looking down and to the side with a faint rueful smile. Blocking lock: Boye's face fills frame centre-right, looking down toward frame left; dim soft background.
Picture 2: Boye, 'Grandpa Bo' (61, male, old network protocol engineer) (character reference; role: the mentor). A 61-year-old Chinese man, retired network protocol engineer who now runs a repair stall. Short grey-white beard, thinning grey hair, black-framed glasses with one temple wrapped in tape, deep wrinkles, gentle stubborn expression. Faded dark navy quilted cotton jacket over a brown knitted vest, a soldering-stained apron.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) — 波爷（六十多岁老人的声音，缓慢、沙哑）: 大家都笑了。我也笑了。
现场环境声：quiet room tone
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

16:9 horizontal, single clip 8.0s, 24fps, a clean oral-history documentary interview recorded in 2078 on a Sony FX6 with a 50mm lens at f/2.8: one soft key light from the left with gentle falloff, true-to-life skin texture, shallow depth of field, neutral colour, calm and restrained; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, close-up, locked-off tripod interview camera, the framing held steady from close-up to close-up with only the faintest breathing drift as he shifts his weight; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Boye's face fills frame centre-right, chin lowered, eyes down toward frame left; the dim concrete wall sits in the background, the empty interviewer side at frame left foreground. Start: he sits still with his head lowered, only his breath moving, the key light resting on the left of his brow and on the rim of his taped glasses. Middle: a faint rueful smile pulls at one corner of his mouth, he lets out one short quiet breath through his nose, then lifts his chin slightly and speaks, his eyes still down, the short grey-white beard moving with his jaw. End: the line finished, he closes his mouth and slowly moves his gaze away toward frame left, off the lens, and holds there without speaking. Mood: remorseful, quiet, honest. Blur: very shallow depth of field, only his eyes and the lenses of his glasses sharp; his beard softens, the shoulder of the quilted jacket and the concrete wall dissolve into a dim even blur. Boye, an old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse, says, <d>[Chinese] 大家都笑了。我也笑了。</d>; Final line of this shot: end on "我也笑了", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.
